feed.title: Bullpen Phone: San Francisco Giants reporter posts

entry.title: San Francisco Giants offseason notes: The Giants agreed to terms on a 2027 contract with Camilo Doval (who will reportedly earn $6.3 million) and tendered contracts LHP Sam Hentges, RHP Randy Rodriguez and INF Casey Schmitt. RHP Rowan Wick and OF Victor Bericoto were non-tendered.
Braxton Roxby: The Nationals also traded RHP Braxton Roxby (who was DFA’d this week) to the Cubs for cash considerations.
Christian Koss: The Giants traded INF Christian Koss to the Rays in exchange for RHP Cole Stokes, a 2026 12-round Draft pick out of Florida State.
Ryan Walker: The Giants traded RHP Ryan Walker to the Brewers in exchange for Minor League RHPs Blake Holub and Gavin Perry.
San Francisco Giants staff and front office: The Giants have officially named James Rowson their new offensive coordinator. Rowson spent the last three seasons as the Yankees' lead hitting coach.

Buster Posey: Buster Posey met with media at GM meetings and said he doubted the Giants will sign any free agents with qualifying offers. Reading between the lines, they are looking at next year as a build-up season.

Reiver Sanmartin: Nationals have acquired LHP Reiver Sanmartin from the Giants for RHP Robert Cranz. Sanmartin, 30, had 4.22 ERA, 1.359 WHIP in 24 games this season, was DFA'd earlier this week. Cranz, 7th round pick in '24, had strong year with Wilmington and Harrisburg, struggled at Rochester.
Duncan Davitt: The #reds have claimed off waivers RHP Duncan Davitt from the Giants and RHP Paxton Shultz from the Nationals.

Nate Furman: Parker and Tena are probably the most-notable moves here. Parker was going to arbitration-eligible after having TJ surgery in July. Tena was out of options and less defensive value than the just-acquired Nate Furman.

Tony Neubeck: The Nationals announce they've acquired 2B/3B Nat Furman from the Giants for minor-league LHP Tony Neubeck. Furman, 25, played in 22 MLB games this season, going 4-for-32. Lefty hitter slashed .292/.377/.414 at AAA. Has 2 more option years. LHP Richard Lovelady was DFA'd to clear a 40-man spot.
Andrew Knizner: The Giants say C Andrew Knizner cleared waivers and was outrighted to Triple-A Sacramento.
